# Original AI marker geometry

Generated by `tools/generate_ai_profile_fixtures.py` with Python 3.11 and the
repository's original modules. No application, settings, account, GPU or model
server is initialized. Storage, BRT/BGT responses and provider objects are fakes.

The four cases execute the unchanged original app methods
`_build_maaiveld_profile_for_layer` and `_dataset_with_template_dekbanden`, the
actual V9 exporter and the isolated original `_ai_maaiveld_points_for_layer`.
They cover virtual and physical TIFF sources, fresh BRT/BGT bounds, independent
context failure, marker-expanded axes, declared band injection, reversed band
chainages, missing end-depth fallback and rotated start/middle/end positions.

Four provider decisions and two CAD inclusion decisions are captured from the
original `_map_export_background_provider` and `_map_export_dxf_overlays`.
Native tests compare all marker coordinates and profile endpoints, not a
reimplementation used as its own reference. Tests also verify that project
source bytes remain unchanged and cancellation precedes context requests.

This oracle establishes geometry and dispatch contracts. It does not assert
pixel-identical text rasterization or the accuracy of real model predictions.
